## RE:volution Mod v2.3.1

### Added

- Added focused regression coverage for the Prestige rune enhancement reset contract across Ordinary, Improved, Advanced, Mythic, future higher ranks, and missing-rune cases.

### Fixed

- Fixed Prestige rune reset so runes below `ADVANCED` reset both rank and enhancement level.
- Preserved both rank and enhancement level for `ADVANCED` and all higher ranks.
- Added per-rune enhancement reset persistence so selective wipes do not clear unrelated rune enhancements in the same collection.

### Other

- Rune Rank Revert behavior remains unchanged and continues to preserve enhancement levels.
- Unlimited rune enhancement progression, permanent collection unlocks, balance values, GUI behavior, Pets, and unrelated gameplay systems are unchanged.
- The reset decision is based on the factual pre-reset rank and therefore automatically preserves future ranks at or above `ADVANCED`.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifacts published for this stable release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v2.3.0...v2.3.1
